about: Standard US card fees for domestic cards, read from each company's own pricing page on the checked date. Your plan, card mix or account can differ, so check your processor's pricing page before you set prices.

square_in_person.label: Card in person (Square)
square_in_person.says: Square Free plan: tap, dip or swipe 2.6% + 15 cents. With Square Free, there are no monthly subscription costs.

square_online.label: Card online or invoice (Square)
square_online.says: Square Free plan: online or invoices 3.3% + 30 cents (card payments made online or through an invoice).

square_keyed.label: Typed-in card or card on file (Square)
square_keyed.says: Square Free plan: manual entry or card on file 3.5% + 15 cents.

stripe_online.label: Card online (Stripe)
stripe_online.says: Stripe standard pricing: 2.9% + 30 cents per successful charge for domestic cards. No setup fees, monthly fees, or hidden fees.

stripe_invoice.label: Invoice (Stripe)
stripe_invoice.says: Stripe Invoicing Starter: 0.4% per paid invoice, on top of Stripe Payments pricing (2.9% + 30 cents for domestic cards).

stripe_in_person.label: Card in person (Stripe)
stripe_in_person.says: Stripe Terminal: 2.7% + 5 cents per successful transaction for domestic cards (Tap to Pay adds 10 cents per authorization).

paypal_checkout.label: PayPal
paypal_checkout.says: PayPal US commercial fees (last updated October 1, 2026): PayPal Checkout 3.49% + 0.49 USD.

paypal_cards.label: Card through PayPal
paypal_cards.says: PayPal US commercial fees (last updated October 1, 2026): standard credit and debit card payments 2.99% + 0.49 USD.

paypal_in_person.label: Card in person (PayPal)
paypal_in_person.says: PayPal Point of Sale, card present transactions: 2.29% + 0.09 USD.

venmo_business.label: Venmo business profile
venmo_business.says: Venmo business profile: the seller transaction fee is a standard rate of 1.9% + $0.10 of the payment total, for payments of $1.00 or more.
